rules.description: Esc -> Esc + switch to ABC input source
Backtick -> switch to ABC, then emit Backtick on key up
Kitty Cmd+Opt+V / Cmd+Shift+V: paste image to safe2

manipulators.description: Caps Lock -> Smart Caps Layer; tap -> native input source switch
Caps + D => Show Desktop via Cmd+Ctrl+Opt+Shift+D
Caps + M => Delete To Line Start
